Definition: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
BiblicalUsage: Keliy means a vessel, an implement, anything prepared for use: Exodus 25:9 says, according to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it. Exodus 40:10 says thou shalt anoint the altar and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar. 1 Chronicles 9:28 says certain Levites had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale. Zechariah 11:15 says, take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a vessel is only as good as its use: the tabernacle's vessels were anointed, the Levites counted them in and out, and the foolish shepherd's instruments were a warning. I hold that God makes vessels for honour, and I want to be one he can use.
